acip: 'DI NI RANG BZHIN GYIS GRUB PA'I GZHAN LAS SKYE NA, GZHAN YIN TSAD THAMS CAD LAS SKYE BAR 'PHEN PA BZHIN DU RANG BZHIN GYIS GRUB PA'I SHES PA CIG SKYE NA, YUL SKRA SHAD MED PAR MTSUNGS PA LA, RAB RIB CAN LA DE MTHONG BA SKYE LA, RAB RIB MED PA LA DE MTHONG BA MI SKYE BA MI 'THAD DE, SHES PA DE RAB RIB LA MI LTOS PAR 'PHUL NUS PAS 'BREL MED DU 'GRO BA'I PHYIR RO,,
english: If something could grow from something other than it which existed through some nature of its own, then that implies that it could grow as well from each & every other object in the universe which was other than it. Just so, if it were possible for one state of mind to grow which existed through some nature of its own, then it would be incorrect to say that—in a case where the strand of hair were equally absent—the sight of it would grow in a person who had cataracts but the sight of it would not grow in a person who had no cataracts. That is, since there would be the potential for this state of mind to make itself known without any dependence upon cataracts, everything would happen without any connection to anything.
